messages.subject: checksum mismatch during deploy
parts:
When I click the "Deploy App" button I get the following error

Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading application bundle...DONE
Deploying application: 15013...
Waiting for task: 546298
  error: Parsing manifest
################################## Begin Log ################################## 
################################### End Log ################################### 
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 546299 failed: Error parsing manifest: Manifest file data/~$Higher Education.xlsx checksum mismatch
Execution halted

There is a file named "data/Higher Education.xlsx" that is part of the app, but there should not be one named "data/~$Higher Education.xlsx". Here is a directory listing

Thanks!

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] checksum mismatch during deploy
parts:
Hi,

I think those are hidden files created when you have a document open in Excel. You may be able to work around by ensuring you don't have those documents open. In the future, we should probably exclude them somehow. I've filed a bug.

-Andy
